reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator leap-day rollover test, PCB DRC). Note: SparkFun makes no RV-3028 Qwiic board, so the widely sold Pimoroni PIM449 (header 2-5V, SDA, SCL, INT, GND, on-board 10k pull-ups) was modelled; the driver handles the datasheet's BSM backup-switchover EEPROM setting and PORF.
